target.title: feat(durable): add opt-in workflow worker loop
target.body:
## Context capsule

This is PR5/5 in the durable runtime stack. It follows the threshold-met PR4 schema lifecycle/recovery hardening and adds the opt-in durable workflow worker loop, now wired into the real gateway lifecycle behind explicit durable worker env flags.

## Durable core stack overview

Durable core means the shared, opt-in runtime substrate that records run identity, step/event ordering, parent/child links, bounded refs, recovery states, signals/timers, and read-only inspection for long-running OpenClaw agent/session/task/subagent work. The full stack is: PR1 #101828 RFC/root-cause/boundary; PR2 #102495 durable runtime core; PR3 #102839 agent/session/subagent restart and upgrade-safety proof; PR4 #102943 schema lifecycle/recovery hardening; PR5 #102983 opt-in workflow worker loop.

## Stack position

- Stack item: PR5/5.
- Upstream gates: PR1 #101828, PR2 #102495, PR3 #102839, and PR4 #102943 are threshold-met in stack state.
- Current PR5 head: `54964adee1` (`fix(durable): wire opt-in worker recovery`).
- Previous below-threshold head: `41d433a127`.

## Dependency / promotion gate

PR5 is the final durable-stack PR. Stack completion still requires a fresh ClawSweeper/reviewer rating at or above gold shrimp/schrimp on this repaired PR5 head.

## What Problem This Solves

After the durable state model, recovery primitives, restart behavior, and schema lifecycle are accepted, OpenClaw needs a worker loop that can execute durable workflow steps without enabling background automation by default. This PR adds that worker path as explicit opt-in automation and proves expired claims can be reclaimed safely.

## Scope

- Wire `startDurableWorkflowWorkerFromEnv` into the actual gateway run loop after gateway startup, next to durable startup/recovery lifecycle handling.
- Keep worker execution disabled unless both durable workflows and `OPENCLAW_DURABLE_WORKER` are explicitly enabled.
- Reclaim expired claimed runs/steps by allowing `recovery_state = 'claimed'` rows with expired claim TTLs to be selected again.
- Add regression coverage for gateway worker lifecycle, env opt-in behavior, and expired-claim reclaim semantics.

## Non-scope

- Does not broaden durable workflows beyond the existing explicit flag model.
- Does not change PR2 durable core boundaries or PR4 schema lifecycle semantics.
- Does not introduce default background execution for existing installs.

## Base / diff hygiene

- PR5 remains stacked as the final durable PR.
- Repair commit is scoped to `src/cli/gateway-cli/run-loop.ts`, `src/cli/gateway-cli/run-loop.test.ts`, `src/durable/sqlite-store.ts`, `src/durable/sqlite-store.test.ts`, and `src/durable/worker.test.ts`.
- `git diff --check` passed on repaired head.

## Proof matrix

| Gate | Command / artifact | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Durable worker/store/gateway proof | `pnpm exec vitest run src/durable/*.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/durable.test.ts --config test/vitest/vitest.unit.config.ts` | passed; 7 files / 27 tests |
| Gateway lifecycle wiring proof | `pnpm exec vitest run src/cli/gateway-cli/run-loop.test.ts --config test/vitest/vitest.cli.config.ts` | passed; 1 file / 37 tests |
| Typecheck | `pnpm tsgo:core` | passed |
| Diff hygiene | `git diff --check` | passed |
| PR5 local-e live smoke | `/tmp/pr5-local-e-worker-smoke-20260709.json` | passed; disabled-by-default stayed stopped/queued, explicit-enable claimed and completed one seeded local-e workflow step |
| Local-e smoke cleanup | `/tmp/pr5-local-e-worker-smoke-cleanup-20260709.json` | passed; cancelled the intentionally queued disabled smoke row after recording evidence |

## Live proof

Environment inspected first: local-e instance manifest, version lock, launchd plist, local-e config, listening port, and logs were checked before mutation. Persistent launchd config was not edited.

PR5-specific local-e smoke used the repaired PR5 source against `/Users/avo/aicos/.runtime-home/openclaw/instances/local-e/state`:

- Disabled/default behavior: `OPENCLAW_DURABLE_WORKFLOWS=1` without `OPENCLAW_DURABLE_WORKER`; `startDurableWorkflowWorkerFromEnv` returned `running: false`, `stopped: true`, and the seeded local-e workflow step remained `queued` / `runnable`.
- Explicit-enable behavior: same local-e state with `OPENCLAW_DURABLE_WORKER=1`; worker `local-e-pr5-enabled` reported `claimedSteps: 1`, completed the seeded step as `succeeded` / `terminal`, and the run became `succeeded` / `terminal`.
- Cleanup: the intentionally queued disabled smoke row was then cancelled so local-e was not left with open test work.

## ClawSweeper requirements

- P1 worker startup wiring: addressed by gateway run-loop integration behind `startDurableWorkflowWorkerFromEnv` and existing explicit env opt-in checks.
- P1 expired claim recovery: addressed by claim queries accepting expired `claimed` rows and regression coverage for stale vs fresh claims.
- P1 real behavior proof: addressed with PR5-specific local-e smoke artifact showing disabled-by-default and explicit-enable behavior.

## Risk / upgrade notes

- Background execution remains opt-in. Without `OPENCLAW_DURABLE_WORKER`, the gateway startup hook creates only a stopped no-op handle.
- Expired claim reclaim preserves fresh claim ownership and only reclaims rows with expired/missing claim expiry metadata.
- The live proof used local-e as the authorized mutable OpenClaw instance and left persistent launchd/config untouched.

## Evidence

- Repair commit: `54964adee1`.
- Durable proof: `pnpm exec vitest run src/durable/*.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/durable.test.ts --config test/vitest/vitest.unit.config.ts` passed, 7 files / 27 tests.
- Gateway lifecycle proof: `pnpm exec vitest run src/cli/gateway-cli/run-loop.test.ts --config test/vitest/vitest.cli.config.ts` passed, 1 file / 37 tests.
- Typecheck: `pnpm tsgo:core` passed.
- Local-e live proof artifact: `/tmp/pr5-local-e-worker-smoke-20260709.json`.
- Local-e cleanup artifact: `/tmp/pr5-local-e-worker-smoke-cleanup-20260709.json`.

## Next gate

Fresh ClawSweeper/reviewer re-review on PR5 #102983 head `54964adee1`. If PR5 reaches threshold and PR1-PR4 remain threshold-met, the durable stack can be marked complete and cron/session follow-up can stop.
